content: Heini he menge lalag impahayag te Nengazen diyà te ki Hoseas he anak ni Beeri dutun te timpu te kedhadì ni Uzia ziyà te Juda, pehendiyà te ki Jotam, ki Ahaz, wey ki Hezekia, ne timpu zaan haazà te kedhadì ni Jeroboam diyà te Israel he anak ni Joash.
Is Esawa wey menge Anak ni Hoseas

Is nehuna he migkaǥi te Nengazen diyà te ki Hoseas ne iyan heini: “Pengesawa ka te vahi he mengungumpadi, ne is menge anak niw ed-isipen he menge anak dutun te vahi he mengungumpadi. Su ebpaahà heini he is menge etew ku, iring te nengumpadi sikandan pinaaǥi te kedselikwaya zan te Nengazen wey ked-azap dan te zuma he menge ed-ezapen.”
Umbe, mid-esawa ni Hoseas si Gomer he anak ni Diblaim. Ne mibmeǥingey si Gomer. Ne hein in-anak en is anak dan he maama,

migkeǥiyan te Nengazen si Hoseas te, “Ngezani nu heeyan is batà te Jezreel, su kenè en egkeuǥet ne edsilutan ku is hadì te Israel tenged te kebpenhimatey te kepuun din he si Jehu ziyà te inged he Jezreel. Id-awè ku is ginhedian te Israel.
Dutun he timpu ebpengelinteuwan ku he mezaag is menge sundaru te Israel ziyà te Suǥud te Jezreel.”

Mid-uman mebmeǥingey si Gomer ne mid-anak te vahi. Ne migkaǥi is Nengazen diyà te ki Hoseas te, “Ngezani nu heeyan is batà te Lo Ruhama, he ke và dà egkegiya, ‘Wazà Mehizuwi,’ su kenè ku en egkehizuwan wey ebpeseyluwen is menge etew te Israel.

Piru egkehizuwan ku mulà is menge etew te Juda. Iyan a, is Nengazen he Megbevayè dan, edlibri kandan pinaaǥi te ǥehem ku ne kenà pinaaǥi te kebpekidtebek he egemiten is panà, ispada, menge kudà etawa pereuntud te kudà.”
Ne hein midlutas en ni Gomer sikan is anak din he si Lo Ruhama, mid-uman sikandin mebmeǥingey ne mid-anak te maama.
Migkaǥi is Nengazen diyà te ki Hoseas te, “Ngezani nu heeyan is batà te Lo Ami, he ke và dà egkegiya, ‘Kenà menge Etew ku,’ su is menge etew te Israel, ne kenè ku menge etew ne kenè e zan Megbevayà.

Piru egkeuma is timpu he egkehizuwan ku sikandan wey edtuvazan ku; egkeiring sikandan kahabet te pantad diyà te veyvey te zaǥat he kenà egkesukud wey egkevilang. Guntaan egngezanan sikandan he ‘Kenà kediey he menge etew,’ piru ziyà te huziyan he timpu egngezanan sikandan te, ‘Menge anak te uuyag he Megbevayà.’
Egkeuman egkesevaha is menge etew te Israel wey Juda, ne ebpilì dan te sevaha he pengulu. Ed-uman dan ed-uswag dutun te tanè dan. Ne utew heeyan melipayen he timpu para te inged he Jezreel.
